subject.title: Bug: partialArgs JSON duplication in agentTurn cron jobs with isolated sessionTarget

question: Should OpenClaw repair only identical duplicated complete tool-call argument objects, or should it change the OpenAI-compatible stream parser contract to replace cumulative chunks from affected providers?
rationale: Both possible fixes affect malformed tool-call semantics and security boundaries around tool execution, and the current open candidate PR is conflicting and proof-incomplete.

options.title: Repair identical duplicates only
options.body: Accept a narrow repair for exact repeated JSON objects while preserving fail-closed behavior for conflicting structured suffixes.

options.title: Change stream contract
options.body: Treat selected provider argument chunks as cumulative snapshots, which needs live provider proof and compatibility checks for normal incremental providers.

options.title: Keep fail-closed
options.body: Reject duplicate structured suffixes until a maintainer accepts the risk of repairing malformed tool arguments.

recommendation.title: Repair identical duplicates only
recommendation.body: Accept a narrow repair for exact repeated JSON objects while preserving fail-closed behavior for conflicting structured suffixes.

likelyOwner.reason: The malformed tool-call recovery history and recent helper maintenance make this the strongest available routing signal for the repair-semantics decision.
